description: This Java class defines a servlet named AddProduct which handles the addition of new products to an online grocery ordering system. It processes form data submitted via POST, interacts with a database utility to insert product details, and manages navigation based on success or failure.

classes.name: AddProduct
classes.description: Servlet class handling product addition in the online grocery system.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to process product addition form submissions.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Processes form data, inserts new product into database, and manages page redirection based on success.
